messages:
Theo: Quick heads-up: vendor pentest booked Mon 2026-11-02 09:00-16:00 UTC. Need an access-handshake plan: RBAC freeze, deploy-hold, KMS decrypt-proxy (no key export), and a sealed presigned snapshot for evidence. Who owns each piece?

Rina: I can take the RBAC freeze + deploy hold. Propose freeze window 08:30-16:30 UTC (pre/post buffers). Will publish exact roles/ARNS by EOD.

Omar: I'll own the sealed snapshot delivery. Plan: produce pt-escrow/snapshots/2411112222_presigned.tar.gz (object-lock enabled), manifest with sha256, and deliver via presigned GET only. Retain for 45 days.

Chen: KMS approach: decrypt-proxy Lambda that assumes a proxy role in our account; assessors assume their ephemeral role in their account and call the proxy. Proxy enforces encryption-context==object-id and logs decrypt calls. No key material leaves account. Need assessor AWS acct and allowed prefixes.

Sahil: Assessor account: 121212121212. We'll provide a signed manifest of allowed prefixes and a small sample presigned URL for testing.

Deploy Bot: Created ticket SEC-PT-9402: access-handshake + sealed-snapshot + decrypt-proxy. Owners: @Rina (freeze), @Omar (snapshot), @Chen (proxy). ETA: 48h for initial artifacts.

Rina: Draft freeze checklist: 1) Pause CI/CD triggers; 2) Deny iam:CreateRole & iam:PutRolePolicy during window; 3) Snapshot pre/post checks; 4) Rollback steps ready. Will post JSON snippet.

Rina: IAM deny snippet (will scope to ARNs):

```
{
  "Statement": [{"Effect":"Deny","Action":["iam:CreateRole","iam:PutRolePolicy"],"Resource":"*","Condition":{"DateGreaterThan":{"aws:CurrentTime":"2026-11-02T08:30:00Z"}}}]
}
```

Chen: KMS condition we plan to gate on: kms:ViaService == "s3.amazonaws.com" AND aws:SourceAccount == "121212121212" and encryption context contains {"evidence-id": "2411112222"}. That ties decrypts to exact objects.

Omar: Snapshot plan: export CloudTrail + host logs + SIEM alerts for window, compress to presigned tar.gz, object-lock Governance mode for 30 days, manifest at pt-escrow/manifests/2411112222.sha256 containing sha256 of tar.gz. Delivery via presigned URL valid 72h.

Sahil: Oncall: if the assessors cause noisy scans or trigger escalations, who triages? Theo primary, Rina backup. If customer-impacting, call IR bridge and mark P1.

Theo: Agreed. If we get a blocker from the pentest that prevents customer traffic, escalate immediately and follow incident runbook IR-PT-2026. Retest cadence: if initial retest fails, allow one 3-business-day remediation sprint then a re-run window.

Rina: Ops note: please pause key rotations for alias/pt-escrow-key from 2026-11-02T06:00Z to 2026-11-02T20:00Z. Also pause automated infra changes.

Deploy Bot: Rotations paused for alias/pt-escrow-key during window. Added note to SEC-PT-9402.

Omar: Acceptance criteria (add one-line to SEC-PT-9402): 1) RBAC freeze applied + rollback validated; 2) presigned sealed snapshot published + sha256 verified; 3) decrypt-proxy logs show proxy assume + decrypt events; 4) oncall escalation validated. Please add by EOD.

Chen: I'll run a staging dry-run of the decrypt-proxy and capture CloudTrail entries; will post a small sample log.

Rina: I'll run a dry-run of the freeze and rollback Friday morning. Will include smoke snapshots.

Theo: Thanks team. Pre-check call Tue 09:00 UTC 10m. Ping in this thread for late changes. :raised_hands:
